name: upli_credit_initializer
description: Common 2.0 2.6/4.3 initial credit publication, one channel, registered outputs; docs/credit_initialization_plan.md.

design_requirements.confirmation_notes: User authorized independent full UALink implementation and selected local Verilator/Yosys/OpenSTA. Agent derives this internal contract from the plan and audited reference model. Account scan order, zero-account bubble and initial pool VC zero are implementation choices, not new normative fields or separately user-approved constants.

behavior: One port independently scans VC0,1,2,3,pool capacities once per reset.
A zero-capacity account contributes one idle cycle; nonzero accounts issue batches of up to four.
No publication before return-direction connection; that connection remains high until reset.
All outputs registered and consumed at the next edge, with no ready handshake.
Done follows the final initial batch by at least one output cycle and remains asserted until reset.
No normal return engine, actual buffer allocation, rate transition or on-wire error recovery.
constraints: Single clock, synchronous reset, one register per sequential always block.
Native UPLI cannot be replaced with AXI; use semantic Chinese same-line comments.
Project snake_case module names are a recorded style adaptation.
notes: No unused ports acquire done or valid.
Capacity must match actual receiver buffers at integration; parameter values alone do not instantiate those buffers.
Explicit local user toolchain overrides remote/backend defaults of the skill.
